Hi! I am Aviral Goel. I am interested in programming language design and
implementation.

I design LLVM-based static analysis tools at Apple for C++ and Swift.
Previously, I worked at Roblox on the Luau programming language. I contributed
to the implementation of Luau's native compiler and associated tools, designed a
sampling profiler to monitor the speedup of native execution over bytecode in
production games, investigated opportunities to improve Luau's native
compilation strategy, and, proposed and implemented attribute support for Luau
to enable developers to select Luau functions for native compilation or mark
them for deprecation.

I have a Ph.D. in Programming Languages from Northeastern University. For my
research, I applied large-scale data-driven approaches to design tools for
migrating the R language ecosystem from lazy to strict semantics with minimal
impact on legacy code.
